title: Turning a model prediction into a safe decision

spans.text: A model only makes a prediction; the Arduino program decides when to act on it. If confidence is low or the sensor is faulty, keep the device in a predefined safe state.

For example, if a vibration model says “unusual,” record the result and check more samples rather than declaring a failure immediately. Test across temperature, noise, sensor variation, and weak Wi-Fi. Input shape, sampling rate, and normalization must match training.

An ESP32 can infer locally and send only a short MQTT alert; it need not upload raw sensor data. When replacing a model, plan version tracking, failure reporting, and a way to restore the previous model.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: A confidence value does not mean the same thing for every model. Choose thresholds using test data and constrain critical actions with independent safety checks.
